key_points: India signed a 10-year contract with Iran to operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar Port.
Enhances land-sea trade route to Afghanistan and Central Asian Republics bypassing Pakistan.
Crucial component of the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC).

current_affairs.topic: RBI's Record Dividend Transfer to Central Government
key_points: Reserve Bank of India approved a record surplus transfer of ₹2.11 lakh crore to the Union Government for FY 2023-24.
Boosted by higher interest income on foreign securities and foreign exchange operations.
Helps fiscal consolidation efforts and lowers the government's net market borrowings.

current_affairs.topic: National Green Hydrogen Mission Progress and VGF Framework
key_points: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy issued guidelines for Viability Gap Funding (VGF) for green hydrogen hubs.
Aims to make India a global hub for production, usage, and export of Green Hydrogen.
Targets production of 5 MMT of Green Hydrogen per annum by 2030.

current_affairs.topic: Supreme Court Ruling on PMLA and Right to Personal Liberty
key_points: Supreme Court clarified strict conditions for arrest under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA).
Emphasized that the right to personal liberty under Article 21 remains paramount.
Mandated clear written grounds of arrest to be provided to the accused at the time of detention.
Government plans expansion of India Semiconductor Mission to build a local supply chain ecosystem.
Focus on compound semiconductors, silicon photonics, and semiconductor packaging (ATMP/OSAT).
Aims to reduce import dependency and strengthen digital infrastructure resilience.
